title: Ethanol + water (the B1 column) with an iteration limit of one: not converged
purpose: (e) A solver that stops before it converges. The B1 column, which has a solution, with the engine's iteration limit set to 1 from a cold start: the result must be not_converged with the residuals by group at the last iterate, never a profile presented as a solution, and the message must say that the column is not shown to be impossible (raise the limit, or start from a previous solution). No open case is known whose reflux-ratio and flow specifications pass the input checks and still have no solution (E1 to E3 are the infeasible ones), so the limit makes the failure certain.
method_choice: docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rule 3: polar, no electrolytes, below 10 bar, with fitted pairs: NRTL (the default set of the pair, fitted-kamihama2012) with an ideal-gas vapour.

behaviour: the residuals by group (material, equilibrium, summation, energy, specifications) at the last iterate are reported, with the tolerances
the message says the solver stopped at its iteration limit, which is not a statement that the separation is impossible, and what to change
with the default limit the same column converges (B1)

numerical.why: No solution to compare: the case checks the outcome and the report.

solver.note: The option's name is W2's; one iteration of any method from a constant-molar-overflow start cannot bring every stage's residuals below 1e-8 (the reference's Newton method needs several from its bubble-point start: fixture checks.reference_iterations).
